name: Fine Structure
description:
Fine Structure turns Claude into a full-stack app team. Describe what you need and Claude builds a complete web application on your Fine Structure account: pages, a managed database, auth and hosting, live at its own URL in minutes.

The destination includes the backend, not just static files. Claude can define data schemas and query records, gate pages behind login, manage app members and access policies, store API keys as secrets, configure integrations, connect custom domains with automatic TLS, create A/B tests, and roll an app back to any saved version.

Typical requests:
"Create a CRM for my landscaping business with customers, jobs and invoices, publish it and give me the live link."
"Add a login-protected admin page to my app and connect the domain app.mybusiness.com."
"Show me the runtime errors in my published app, fix them and republish."

Connecting takes one click: sign in to your Fine Structure account (free tier available) and approve access. Everything Claude does is revocable from your account's MCP tokens panel, and every change can be rolled back to a saved version.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fine Structure to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fine Structure to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fine Structure MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fine Structure lists 82 MCP tools, including add_custom_domain, add_file_change, agency_create_claim_link, agency_create_client, agency_create_client_app, agency_get_claim_status, agency_list_clients, apply_change_set, attach_agent_whatsapp, check_domain_verification, compare_current_to_version, and compare_saved_versions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fine Structure?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fine Structure in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Fine Structure MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fine Structure requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fine Structure is developed by Fine Structure. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
